description: This file defines account types, permissions constants, and a static class OA_Permission providing methods for managing user permissions, account access, and related security checks within the Revive Adserver project.

classes.name: OA_Permission
classes.description: A static class providing methods for permission management, account access control, and security enforcement within the Revive Adserver.

methods.name: checkSessionToken
methods.description: Checks for a valid session token to prevent CSRF vulnerabilities.

methods.name: enforceTrue
methods.description: Enforces a condition, displaying an error message and redirecting if false.

methods.name: enforceAccount
methods.description: Ensures the current user account matches specified account types, attempting to switch if necessary.

methods.name: isAccount
methods.description: Checks if the current user's account type matches given types.

methods.name: getCurrentUser
methods.description: Retrieves the current user object from the session.

methods.name: redirectIfManualAccountSwitch
methods.description: Redirects if the user has manually switched accounts.

methods.name: isManualAccountSwitch
methods.description: Checks if the user has manually switched accounts.

methods.name: attemptToSwitchToAccount
methods.description: Attempts to switch the current session to a specified account type.

methods.name: getLinkedAccounts
methods.description: Returns accounts linked to the current user, optionally grouped by account type.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Retrieves the user ID of the current user.

methods.name: generateAccountName
methods.description: Generates a display name for an account, appending status labels.

methods.name: mergeAdminAccounts
methods.description: Merges admin accounts with associated manager accounts.

methods.name: switchAccount
methods.description: Switches the active account in the session.

methods.name: hasAccess
methods.description: Checks if the user has access to a specific account.

methods.name: isUserLinkedToAccount
methods.description: Checks if a user is linked to a specific account.

methods.name: isUserLinkedToAdmin
methods.description: Checks if a user is linked to the admin account.

methods.name: enforceAccess
methods.description: Enforces access to an account, throwing error if not authorized.

methods.name: enforceAllowed
methods.description: Enforces that the user has specific permission on an account.

methods.name: hasPermission
methods.description: Checks if the user has a specific permission on an account.

methods.name: getAccountId
methods.description: Returns the currently active account ID.

methods.name: getAccountType
methods.description: Returns the current account type, optionally as a string.

methods.name: isPermissionRelatedToAccountType
methods.description: Checks if a permission is related to a specific account type.

methods.name: getAccountUsersPermissions
methods.description: Retrieves permissions assigned to a user for a specific account.

methods.name: enforceAccountPermission
methods.description: Enforces that the user has specific permission for an account type.

methods.name: checkAccountPermission
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission for an account type.

methods.name: enforceAccessToObject
methods.description: Enforces access to a specific data object, switching accounts if necessary.

methods.name: hasAccessToObject
methods.description: Checks if the user has access to a specific data object.

methods.name: _hasAccessToObject
methods.description: Internal method to verify access to a data object.

methods.name: getAccountTable
methods.description: Returns the database table name associated with an account type.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the entity ID associated with the current user account.

methods.name: callAccessHook
methods.description: Invokes registered plugin hooks to determine object access permissions.

methods.name: getAccountIdForEntity
methods.description: Retrieves the account ID associated with a specific entity.

methods.name: attemptToSwitchForAccess
methods.description: Attempts to switch to an account that has access to a specific entity.

methods.name: switchToManagerAccount
methods.description: Switches session to the manager account owning a specific entity.

methods.name: switchToSystemProcessUser
methods.description: Switches user context for system processes or restores previous user.

methods.name: isAccountTypeId
methods.description: Checks if current user's account type matches given ID(s).

methods.name: convertAccountTypeToId
methods.description: Converts account type string to its integer ID constant.

methods.name: setAccountAccess
methods.description: Sets or removes user access to an account.

methods.name: _accountTypeSort
methods.description: Private method to sort account types by predefined order.

methods.name: getUsername
methods.description: Retrieves the username of the current user.

methods.name: getAgencyId
methods.description: Retrieves the agency ID associated with the current user.

methods.name: getAccountName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the current account.

methods.name: isUsernameAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a username is available and allowed for use.

methods.name: userNameExists
methods.description: Checks if a username already exists.

methods.name: getUniqueUserNames
methods.description: Retrieves a list of unique usernames, optionally removing a specific one.

methods.name: storeUserAccountsPermissions
methods.description: Stores permissions for a user on an account.

methods.name: deleteExistingPermissions
methods.description: Deletes existing permissions for a user on an account.

methods.name: getOwnedAccounts
methods.description: Returns all account IDs owned by a given account.

methods.name: getAccountTypeByAccountId
methods.description: Retrieves the account type string for a specific account ID.
